items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Eddie and I got along fine... Cootie had him to play first part... I'm sittin' there, and I ain't doin' nothin' -- playin' the third part

ctx.x: Now, I was saying that this showed a little example of Eddie. When I was talking about Lee Polk... Lee Polk had come in a little bit later, and Eddie and him became very good friends. But when they'd get to drinking... Now, one night we were playing at the Golden Gate Ballroom, New Year's Eve night, and Lee was on one side
